section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis methods used in the study. The researchers used SPSS Statistics (version 23) to screen variables for errors and outliers, calculate descriptive statistics, and conduct correlation analysis among BMI, body appreciation (BA), and weight loss (WL). A PROCESS analysis with Model 4 was employed to test the mediating role of body appreciation, with BMI as the independent variable, BA as the mediator, and WL as the dependent variable, using 1000 bias-corrected bootstrap samples with a significance level of p < 0.05.
